claims.claim: Huang and colleagues used LASSO-Cox, random survival forests and best subset selection to select predictor sets, then built three candidate Cox prediction models.
Huang and colleagues developed the models in Whitehall II, externally evaluated them in ELSA, and reported five-, ten- and fifteen-year risk estimates.
The first author of PMID 38088426, DOI 10.1097/HJH.0000000000003626, is Yoshinori Sasagawa.
Wu and colleagues used a Japanese NAGALA cohort for external validation in addition to their internal validation split.
